title: DL-016 Interference Audit — Scan Reliability Risk Assessment
finding: DL-016 dual-block architecture does NOT exist in current files. All packs are single-object. However, CC-before-QID position creates identical DL-029 forward-scan vulnerability on ALL packs.

architecture.current: ALL 5 packs use SINGLE-OBJECT architecture. Each QuestionID has exactly one JSON object. All content and metadata fields coexist in the same object.
architecture.historical: The DL-016 entry in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md describes a paired-object structure (metadata block with flat ChoiceA-D + content block with nested Choices.{A-D}). This historical format has been normalized away. 0 'ChoiceA' flat fields exist in any current pack file.
architecture.cc_position: CorrectChoice appears BEFORE QuestionID in ALL 5 packs without exception. Average CC-to-QID distance: ~1,058 characters.
architecture.object_size: Average JSON object size between consecutive CC fields: 3,639 chars (min 2,851, max 7,321)

forward_scan_false_positive_rate.mechanism: Scanner finds 'QuestionID' → searches forward for 'CorrectChoice' → finds NEXT QID's CC (since CC is before QID, not after)
forward_scan_false_positive_rate.rate: ~75% across ALL 5 packs. With uniform CC distribution (A/B/C/D at ~25% each), probability that adjacent QIDs share same CC ≈ 25%.
forward_scan_false_positive_rate.prior_scoping_error: DL-029 originally stated the forward-scan problem only affects Pack B. This is incorrect — it affects ALL packs equally.

governance_guard_rule2_analysis.method: ±1200 character window scan around each ExplanationWrong match, searching in BOTH directions
governance_guard_rule2_analysis.reliability: Partially immune — direction-agnostic and edit-scoped. But vulnerable on large objects (>2,400 chars) where CC-EW distance exceeds window.
governance_guard_rule2_analysis.verdict: More reliable than forward-scan but not fully safe on packs C/D where objects average 3,639 chars

current_dl008_count_reliability.session_status_67: STALE — produced by forward-scan methodology. All 67 items individually verified CLEAN via Function constructor same-object parse.
current_dl008_count_reliability.session_92_672: ALSO STALE — produced by window-scan methodology with DL-020 (brace-matcher string-unawareness) artifacts. All items verified CLEAN per S801 authoritative parse.
current_dl008_count_reliability.s801_authoritative: 0 Certified DL-008 items across all 5 packs. Function constructor parse, same-object CC+EW extraction. 100% confidence.

recommended_scanning_methodology.description: Parse pack file to actual JS objects. Extract CC and EW from exact same object. Immune to field-ordering and cross-QID artifacts.
Since CC is always before QID, scanning backward links CC to correct QID reliably.
Find object boundaries via string-aware brace tracking. Extract CC and EW from same body.

avoid: Separate regex passes for CC and EW that rely on positional indexing
Totals-only reports without QID lists (per AGENTS.md §5)
